tours.title: One book, many kinds: Ibn al-Jawzī's *Talbīs Iblīs*

stops.title: Find the book
stops.text:
Start here: type a few letters of a title, an author's name or a URI into this box. Accents don't matter: “talbis iblis” finds *Talbīs Iblīs*.
Then click the title in the list to open its profile.

stops.title: Overview
stops.text: As a whole text, the book scores 100% biographical. Read window by window, only about 40% is: legal, Tradition-based and theological types appear beside it.

stops.title: Through the text
stops.text:
Each point is a window of about 3,000 words, stepped along the text.
The leading type keeps changing: as Ibn al-Jawzī moves from subject to subject, the kind of writing changes too.

stops.title: Through the text, with headers
stops.text:
The black lines mark the book's chapters, listed in the table below, and the changes follow them. The opening chapters read as Tradition-based: their argument is built from ḥadīṯ reports. Chapters 6–8, on scholars, authorities and worshipers, read as legal.
Chapter 10, the long critique of Ṣūfī practices, reads as biographical: its anecdotes resemble those of biographical collections.

stops.title: Inside one chapter
stops.text:
Chapter 5 shows the same thing on a small scale. On beliefs and doctrines it reads as scholastic-theological; on the idol-worshipers of the *jāhiliyyaŧ*, as historical; on the Ḫārijites and the Šīʿaŧ, as biographical.
The added lines are the level-2 headers, the chapter's sections.

stops.title: Entropy compared
stops.text: Entropy measures how varied the vocabulary is. Among the works of its top type, biographical, this book sits above most.

stops.title: Similar books
stops.text: The works whose vocabulary is closest: more than half are biographical by top type, the rest of several other types.

stops.title: Author
stops.text:
Ibn al-Jawzī's books in the corpus spread over many types: biographical, Tradition-based, exegetical, legal, poetic and linguistic.
In *All books*, each column is one book. Click any title in the list below to open its profile.
